finish.text:
Added the cheapest available Electronics item to the cart.

Item: USB-C Charging Cable 6ft Refurbished
Price: $7.99
Quantity: 1
Cart subtotal: $7.99 (1 item)
Seller: OEM Reseller (ships from and sold by Amazon.com)
Stock: In Stock

How it was found: opened the Electronics category (50 results), applied the page's "Price: Low to High" sort, and took the first result. Out-of-stock items were excluded - the $15.00 "2 Pack Portable Charger" and the $18.82 "Amazon Basics Bluetooth Earbuds" both showed "Currently unavailable". The chosen item sat at the top of the ascending list, with every item from the fifth position down priced at $15.00 or higher.

Verification: the cart page lists the item with quantity 1 and a subtotal of $7.99, and the header cart badge changed from 0 to 1 item.

One thing worth flagging: the first two Add to Cart clicks showed an "Added to Cart" confirmation banner but added nothing - the cart stayed empty. The cause was that the quantity dropdown had no committed value. After setting Qty to 1 explicitly, the add worked. On this site the confirmation toast alone is not proof that an item was added.

Did not proceed to checkout, since the request only asked for the item to be in the cart.
